name: Call of Air
summary: At Grommash Hold, Searn Firewarder sends seasoned shamans south for the Air Totem. Prate Cloudseer guides them through the final element of their craft.

sections.title: A Breath from the South
sections.body: You have earned the favor of earth, fire, and water. Now you travel south from Orgrimmar across the Barrens, then down into the canyons of Thousand Needles to learn the last element: air. Troll trainer Searn Firewarder sends you when he sees you are ready for this final step in your early training.

sections.title: The Cloudseer's Hermitage
sections.body: Prate Cloudseer waits in a high cave among the sandstone mesas of Thousand Needles. She lives quietly with her partner, far from Horde encampments, and expects you to show deference before she shares the secrets of the wind. Meet her with proper respect, and she teaches you the knowledge and focus to manifest the Air Totem. Then your circle of elemental craft is complete.

aliases: where to get call of air
faq.answer: Searn Firewarder, a troll shaman trainer in Grommash Hold, sends qualified shamans when they are ready for this step.

faq.q: Where can I find Prate Cloudseer?
faq.answer: Prate Cloudseer lives in Thousand Needles. Take the Great Lift down from the southern Barrens, then travel east across the canyon floor to find her cave.

faq.q: What is the Air Totem used for?
faq.answer: The Air Totem is the fourth and final elemental focus a shaman acquires. It lets a shaman call on air spells and totems, with speed, grace, and powers of the wind.

faq.q: Why does Searn Firewarder send you so far away?
faq.answer: Mastery of the elements means finding mentors devoted to particular spirits. Prate Cloudseer knows the winds of Thousand Needles' shifting canyon gusts, making her a fitting guide to air.

faq.q: Do I need to complete other elemental totem quests first?
aliases: can i do air totem first
faq.answer: Yes. Shaman training follows a set order through the elements: earth, then fire and water, and finally air.

faq.q: Are there other versions of this quest for different cities?
faq.answer: Yes. Shaman trainers in other Horde capitals, including Thunder Bluff, send shamans to Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.

angles.text: The Air Totem marks the last step in your early shamanic journey. With it, you call on wind spirits alongside earth, fire, and water.
Your shamanic tradition binds the Horde's diverse races together. Elders and hermits across central Kalimdor pass down its sacred customs.
